title: Pickle Plant - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Delosperma echinatum
description:
Unique and charming succulent, perfect for desks and sunny windowsills!




 KEY FEATURES


• Unique barrel-shaped leaves with soft white bristles


• Compact size, ideal for small spaces and windowsills


• Produces charming daisy-like yellow flowers in summer


• Low maintenance and drought-tolerant


• Pet friendly




 PLANT DETAILS


Type: Cacti & Succulents — Delosperma echinatum


Colour: Green foliage, yellow flowers


Season: Flowers in summer


Growth Habit: Shrubby, upright or trailing




 GROWING CONDITIONS


Sun: Full sun


Soil: Cactus compost or well-draining soil


Watering: Water moderately, allowing soil to dry out between waterings. Reduce watering in winter.


Spacing: 5-10cm between plants


Height: 10-30cm


Spread: 10-30cm


Hardiness: H1b (can be grown outside in summer, 10-15°C)




 CARE INSTRUCTIONS


• Provide bright, direct sunlight for at least 2 hours daily.


• Water only when the soil has completely dried out; avoid overwatering to prevent root rot.


• Feed monthly with a liquid cacti and succulent fertiliser from spring to summer.


• Ensure good drainage; do not let the plant sit in water.


• Protect from frost; best kept indoors in cooler climates.




 WHAT'S INCLUDED


2x Mini Plug Plants of Delosperma echinatum (Pickle Plant)
